title: Manage rows — match the model menu

steps.path: Sessions menu → New session → Project folder
steps.headline: "Manage projects…" now reads as the list's last row, like "Manage models…" in the model menu.
steps.changed: The centred grey line above it is gone. It now has a small folder icon, lined up with the project icons, and soft grey words aligned with the project names.
steps.notice: The three pickers (models, projects, tags) end the same way, so the way out to their manage screens is in the same spot with the same look.
steps.risk: Its folder icon matches the project rows, so at a glance it could be mistaken for a project. The softer grey and the "…" are what set it apart.

steps.path: A session's tag chip → Tags & note
steps.headline: "Manage tags…" gets a tag icon and lines up with the tag names.
steps.changed: It was tiny loose text under the list. Now it is a full row, slightly larger, with a tag icon in the colour-square column and a hover highlight like the tags above it.
steps.measured: Text goes from 9 px to 10 px, the size of the tag names
steps.notice: Easier to spot and to click; it behaves like the rows above it.
steps.risk: The box grows by about 4 px.
